lines.zh: 我走一步，皮肉就错位一下。
lines.en: Each step shifts my flesh out of place.
New mouths open in my patches.
An extra joint has grown in my leg.
I move slowly along the fence.
A wet trail follows behind me.
I don't chew grass anymore.

lines.zh: 走过的地方草丛萎下去。
lines.en: The grass wilts where I pass.
My breath smells of raw meat.
I head toward the shed.
I drag my steps, slowly.
One of my horns is crooked.
I don't low anymore.
Blood seeps from my flank.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙根挪，皮蹭掉一层。
lines.en: I slide along the wall's foot, scraping off a layer of hide.
My shadow trembles.
I turn toward beyond the fence.

lines.zh: 我站着，身上有东西在动。
lines.en: I stand, something moving under my hide.
My eyes carry two pupils each.

lines.zh: 远处有东西在响，我竖着耳朵。
lines.en: Something's making noise far off, and my ears are up.

lines.zh: 我的舌头伸出来又缩回。
lines.en: My tongue extends and retracts.
Something bulges at my ribs, then flattens.

lines.zh: 地上的草在我脚边发黑。
lines.en: The grass blackens at my feet.

lines.zh: 我把头歪成一个不自然的角度。
lines.en: I tilt my head at an unnatural angle.

lines.zh: 我数心跳，数到一半就乱了。
lines.en: I count my heartbeats until the count falls apart.
Some flies circle me.

lines.zh: 我不吃草，胃里照样在响。
lines.en: I don't eat grass, yet my gut keeps rumbling.
I twist my neck around.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤很薄，里面是红的。
lines.en: My skin is thin, and red inside.
I exhale, and it's hot.

lines.zh: 我身后空空的，尾巴早没了。
lines.en: It's empty behind me; my tail has been gone a while.
I'm still growing.

lines.zh: 我站着没动，身上自己动着。
lines.en: I stand still, yet things inside me keep moving.
You smell of fresh blood.
I lift my head to you.
My neck twists too far.
You've looked at me already.

lines.zh: 你还认得这身皮原来的样子吗。
lines.en: Do you still recognize what this hide used to be?

lines.zh: 我迈着不稳的腿，一点点靠近。
lines.en: On unsteady legs I close the distance inch by inch.
My mouth is wider than it was.

lines.zh: 你一后退，草叶就露了馅。
lines.en: The moment you step back, the grass gives you away.
The fence won't hold me.

lines.zh: 你一出汗，味就飘到我鼻子里。
lines.en: The moment you sweat, the smell drifts into my nose.
There's something in my teeth.
I'm deciding where to bite.
The mouths on me all close.
Blood runs from several places.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，腿不太听话。
lines.en: I step back; my legs don't obey.
I let out a muffled sound.
A flap of my hide peels open.

lines.zh: 疼的时候，里面的东西一起动。
lines.en: When it hurts, everything inside me moves at once.
I straighten again.

lines.zh: 这一下很疼，很久没疼了。
lines.en: It hurts; I haven't hurt in a while.
I keep my eye on you.
I came on anyway.
This smell is meat, not grass.
I don't eat grass anymore.
Your hands are bloody.
I come when I smell blood.

lines.zh: 这么一点，填不住我身上的口。
lines.en: That little won't fill the mouths on my body.
I lower my head for it.
I still remember what eating felt like.

lines.zh: 手放低些，我够起来费劲。
lines.en: Lower your hand; reaching up costs me too much.
Don't move when I come near.
I open my mouth; the teeth are wrong.
I bite at the air.
I ate this once.

lines.zh: 再来一块，我还没尝出味。
lines.en: Another piece — I haven't even tasted this one yet.
I can't chew grass.
I only want to eat.
The smell on your hands is strong.
You hit me; it's soft.

lines.zh: 我身上的东西动了一下。
lines.en: Something on me shifts.
You step back, blood on your clothes.
There's hardly any bone left in me.

lines.zh: 挤得太紧，我身上的口被压开。
lines.en: We're packed so tight that the mouths on me are squeezed open.

lines.zh: 你脚下踩到了我的一块。
lines.en: You stepped on a piece of me.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向偏了一下。
lines.en: I tilt toward you.
I bent the fence.

lines.zh: 这点碰撞我没什么感觉。
lines.en: I barely felt that.
I haven't moved.
There's another in the shed.
It's changing the same way I am.
Our hides press together.
The mouths on it are opening too.
We walk toward the gate together.
It made a sound; not bovine.
We don't tell ourselves apart anymore.
The calf isn't here.
We rub against the wooden rail.
We look the same way.

lines.zh: 蹄边有块东西，我低头拱起。
lines.en: There's something by my hoof; I lower my head and scoop it up.
It slides between my hooves.

lines.zh: 这东西在我牙下碎成两半。
lines.en: This thing splits in two under my teeth.
This is bone.
There's meat on it still.
I hold it under my bulk.
I can't get this thing down my throat.

lines.zh: 太硬了，我嚼两下就吐了。
lines.en: Too hard — two chews and I spit it out.
It's covered in blood.
I drag it behind the hay.
The blood smell comes closer.
I stop and turn my head.
My body starts to swell.
There's something alive past the fence.
I take one step toward it.
My mouth opens slowly.
The fence rattles.

lines.zh: 我把蹄子迈开，草全踩平。
lines.en: I stretch out my stride and flatten the grass underfoot.

lines.zh: 它一转身，我的头就跟着转。
lines.en: It turns to run, and my head follows the turn.
I followed.
I trail by the blood smell.
The fence bends and I squeeze through.
The grass blackens under me.

lines.zh: 它回头看了一次，我没停。
lines.en: It looked back once, and I didn't stop.
I'm still behind.
Its shadow is nearly on me.
It ran into the field.
There's no cover in the field.
I follow its blood smell.
My legs are wrong, but they'll do.
I ram it; flesh meets flesh.
It's pinned under me.
My teeth bite; they're blunt.
Blood sprays on my face.

lines.zh: 它挣着要走，我拿角抵住。
lines.en: It struggles to get away; I brace it with my horn.

lines.zh: 牙陷进它的肩窝，我往下压。
lines.en: My teeth sink into the hollow of its shoulder and I bear down.
The mouths on my body are biting too.
It twitches once, then goes still.
I'm still biting down.
The smell suddenly changed.
An extra shape in the shed.
I rise from behind the hay.
There's blood all over the fence posts.
The mouths on me open first.
My legs don't stand quite right.
The air smells of blood.
I turn about.
I used to stand here.
It's different now.
I hear cattle lowing far off.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的皮，脂肪在响。
lines.en: Fire cooks my hide; the fat crackles.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，骨头声音不对。
lines.en: I hit the ground; the bones sound wrong.
Water pours into the mouths on me.
The blast tears a piece off me.
A point pierces my hide.

lines.zh: 光打在我身上，里面在烧。
lines.en: Light strikes me; something burns inside.

lines.zh: 饿到现在，我连草都想咬。
lines.en: I'm so starved now that even grass looks worth biting.
Lightning enters; everything in me jerks.
No ground, no grass.
